title: andira anthelminthica
intro: Andira anthelminthica, commonly known as Andira or Guiné, is a plant species native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiparasitic effects, aiding in the treatment of various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Andira anthelminthica include its ability to act as an anthelmintic, helping to expel intestinal parasites, as well as its use in treating gastrointestinal disorders and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Andira anthelminthica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
